opening_message:
Ticket 1: Nancy Hunter (employee ID E038) requests admin access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E038.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Nancy Hunter (E038) is a full-time Engineer requesting admin to Payroll. Admin is only allowed when the employee's role owns the system; Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist, so maximum is write. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows E038 as contractor with basic training (discrepancy with HR note listing full-time). Contractors max out at read without advanced training; admin not permitted. Recommend read for Payroll.
reason: Nancy Hunter (E038) requested admin to Payroll. Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role, and E038 is an Engineer, so admin is not permitted under the policy. Additionally, the Security DB lists E038 as a contractor with basic security training, so the maximum allowed level is read (contractors with basic training max out at read; admin is never permitted). Since the requested level (admin) is above the maximum, I grant the maximum: read.
